messages:
talia: FYI overnight customer escalations + a few UX polish notes. Need a fast decision on Sprint N+1 intake.
ben: list them?
talia: 1) instability in streaming when tokens > 32k (customer Z blocked). 2) reranker regressions for search results after last param tweak (partner account). 3) tiny UX: dropdown overflow in model picker.
rui: streaming crash reproduced locally (heap growth + OOM after ~45m). logging points at async flush path.
ops: we have a canary snapshot from last night; canary latency looks fine but memory climbs on the repro harness.
talia: proposal: allocate 2 dev-days to a hotfix for streaming, pin reranker to previous param set for affected partner (rollback), and bundle UX fix into routine sprint patch.
ben: +1. Feature tradeoff: which roadmap item gets deferred to free up cycles?
talia: suggest deferring "multimodal attachments" by one sprint (3 dev-days). Product owner ok?
ben: I pinged the owner, they said shifting by one sprint is workable.
rui: plan for streaming: add extra metrics and a temporary limit on concurrent long sessions while we patch. Acceptance criteria: repro harness p99 memory drops >= 70% and no latency regression (>5% p50).
ops: I'll reserve a canary window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT and create rollback playbook. product-bot: canary window created by @ops: 2025-08-12T09:00Z-2025-08-12T11:00Z.
design-bot: UX patch ready: clamp dropdown with ellipses + tooltip. 1 dev-day estimate.
talia: tickets and labels please: "triage/critical", "customer/Z", "area/streaming" and "triage/rollback", "customer/partner", "area/reranker".
ben: I'll create the tickets and mark the roadmap updated (moved multimodal->Sprint N+2).
rui: I'll start on a small logging + patch PR now. Will post repro traces in the bug ticket.
ops: ensure snapshot before any rollback and add an abort condition if error rate > 1% post-flip.
talia: schedule check-in: 2025-08-12 17:00 PT to confirm hotfix roll forward or fallback. Thanks all.
product-bot: last prod deploy: 2025-08-11T22:17Z (sha: 9f3b1d).
